meta.title: Header Editor Pro - Free Chrome Extension for HTTP Header Modification
meta.description: Free Chrome extension to modify HTTP request and response headers. Unlimited profiles, 7 languages, real-time editing, zero data collection. Open source and always free.
meta.ogTitle: Header Editor Pro - Free HTTP Header Editor
meta.ogDescription: Modify HTTP headers in Chrome for free. Unlimited profiles, 7 languages, API testing, CORS debugging. Open source, no tracking.
meta.twitterDescription: Free Chrome extension for HTTP header modification. Unlimited profiles, zero tracking.
meta.schemaDescription: Professional HTTP header editor for Chrome and Firefox. Modify request and response headers with unlimited profiles, real-time editing, and zero data collection.
hero.title: Edit HTTP headers, redirect requests and add cookies — one profile per environment
hero.subtitle: A free, open-source extension for Chrome and Firefox. Test against staging, debug auth and CORS, and switch environments without touching code.
hero.meta: Free · Open source · No account · No tracking
hero.imageAlt: The extension popup with a Staging profile: request headers, a note and a redirect
features.title: What it does
features.headers.title: Request and response headers
features.headers.body: Set, append or remove any header. Each one has its own switch and an optional note, so six months from now you still know why that token is there.
features.headers.alt: Request headers with a note open below the Authorization header
features.redirects.title: Redirects between environments
features.redirects.body: Send requests that match a regular expression to another URL — staging, a local server — using $1 capture groups. Turn on CORS when the target is on another origin.
features.redirects.alt: Two redirects, one of them with CORS enabled
features.cookies.title: Cookies per profile
features.cookies.body: Add cookies to a domain's requests without writing them to the browser. They stop the moment you pause or switch profile, and a warning tells you when the site already sets one with the same name.
features.cookies.alt: Managed cookies, one of them flagged because the site already has a cookie with that name
more.title: Also included
more.profiles.title: Profiles and filters
more.profiles.body: As many profiles as you need, each limited to some domains or, in Chrome, to a tab group.
more.import.title: Import and export
more.import.body: JSON backups, profile lists from other header editors, and Requestly redirect rules.
more.share.title: Share what's on
more.share.body: Copy a profile's enabled items; a teammate imports them as a ready-made profile.
more.pause.title: Pause
more.pause.body: Turn every rule off in one click without losing any of them.
more.append.title: Set or append
more.append.body: Append to multi-value headers such as Accept or Cookie instead of replacing them.
more.ui.title: Light or dark, 7 languages
more.ui.body: English, Español, 日本語, 한국어, Русский, 简体中文, 繁體中文.
uses.title: Common uses
uses.flags: Force a feature flag or A/B variant
privacyNote.title: Your data stays in your browser
privacyNote.body: Profiles are stored locally. The extension has no servers, no analytics and no account, and the rules run inside the browser itself, so it never sees the requests it changes. The code is on GitHub if you want to check.
sticky.text: Free — and nobody pays me to maintain it.
support.title: Free, and nobody's paying for it
support.body: This extension costs nothing, and no one pays me to maintain it or to build new things into it. It gets better in my own time.
support.issues: Want something improved? Open an issue and let's talk it through — that's free too, and it's the best way in.
support.wink: Chip in and your request moves up my queue. And if you'd rather not, no hard feelings — nobody ever turned down a glass of water ;)
support.footer: Either way, it stays free for everyone.
privacy.meta.title: Privacy Policy - Header Editor Pro Free Chrome Extension
privacy.meta.description: Privacy policy for Header Editor Pro - Free. Zero data collection, all configurations stored locally. Your privacy is our priority.
privacy.meta.ogTitle: Privacy Policy - Header Editor Pro Free
privacy.meta.ogDescription: Zero data collection. All configurations stored locally on your device.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy - Header Editor Pro - Free
privacy.callout.label: Your Privacy Matters:
privacy.callout.body: This extension is designed with privacy first. We do not collect, store, or transmit any personal data.
privacy.collection.title: Data Collection
privacy.collection.body: Header Editor Pro - Free does not collect, store, or transmit any personal user data to external servers. The extension operates entirely within your browser and does not communicate with any remote services.
privacy.storage.title: Local Storage
privacy.storage.intro: All header configurations, profiles, and settings are stored locally on your device using the browser's storage API. This data includes:
privacy.storage.item1: Header rules, redirects, managed cookies and profiles
privacy.storage.outro: This data never leaves your computer and is only accessible by the extension itself. You can clear this data at any time by removing the extension or clearing your browser data.
privacy.permissions.title: Permissions
privacy.permissions.intro: The extension requires the following permissions to function:
privacy.permissions.dnr: To modify HTTP headers, redirect requests and add your managed cookies to requests
privacy.permissions.tabGroups: To read the name and colour of a Chrome tab group, so a profile can be scoped to one
privacy.permissions.cookies: To list, copy or delete the cookies of the site in the active tab when you open "This site's cookies", and to warn you when a cookie you manage clashes with one the site already has. Cookies are read only on those actions, shown to you, and never stored elsewhere or sent anywhere.
privacy.permissions.allUrls: Header rules are applied by the browser itself through declarativeNetRequest. The extension does not read page content, and never sees the requests it modifies.
privacy.permissions.outro: These permissions are used solely for the extension's functionality and not for data collection.
privacy.thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
privacy.thirdParty.body: This extension does not integrate with or send data to any third-party services, analytics platforms, or advertising networks.
privacy.updates.title: Updates to This Policy
privacy.updates.body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected in the extension and the updated date below.
privacy.contact.title: Contact
privacy.contact.body: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or the extension's data practices, please contact us through the extension's support channels on GitHub.
